item.title: GTA 6's original score by Justice comes out December 11, after The Album's 34 songs
item.description: Justice's Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score arrives December 11 with 30 tracks and a three-hour suite of bonus music. Here's how it differs from GTA VI: The Album, the 34-song soundtrack that's already out.

item.title: GTA 6 doubled UK games retail sales in launch week, but it isn't GTA V in the shops
item.description: NielsenIQ's UK figures for GTA VI's launch week: £142 million of games retail, £32 million of boxed GTA VI copies, and a rush on controllers and SSDs. Why the boxed number ranks only 17th all-time.

item.title: GTA 6 in Japan is a censored version: no nudity, less blood and fewer languages
item.description: GTA VI's Japanese release covers up nudity, tones down blood and has fewer language options than the global version. What players in Japan have found, and what stays the same.

item.title: Digital Foundry's big GTA 6 console comparison: Xbox Series X runs it better than the standard PS5
item.description: Digital Foundry put GTA VI on all four consoles side by side. The PS5 Pro is still the best place to play, but the Xbox Series X beats the standard PS5 with fewer frame rate drops. Here's the full ranking.

item.title: Rockstar explains two GTA 6 design choices: why there's no mission replay, and what the Criminal Profile is for
item.description: GTA VI's story missions can't be replayed, and your Criminal Profile can lock you in as Irredeemable. Two Rockstar leads have now explained why the game works this way.

item.title: GTA 6 hides Mario and Luigi caps in Lummox County, and Arthur Morgan's hat is at a yard sale
item.description: Two of GTA VI's best hidden extras are things you can wear: a secret block in the hills that drops J and L plumber caps, and a $35 cowboy hat straight out of Red Dead Redemption 2. Here's where to find both.

item.title: Digital Foundry tested GTA 6's Xbox '60 fps glitch': it averages about 36 fps and speeds the game up
item.description: A Quick Resume trick lifts GTA VI's 30 fps cap on Xbox Series X|S. Digital Foundry measured it: 60 fps only when you're flying and looking at the sky, about 36 fps on average, and a game that runs too fast. Here's what that means.

item.title: GTA 6's biggest secret so far: a power-line puzzle that opens a portal to 2002's Vice City
item.description: A YouTuber spent three days following power lines across Leonida and found a hidden portal back to a PS2-style Vice City. Here's what's known about the puzzle, how well it's confirmed, and what you get.

item.title: GTA 6's in-game trading cards are becoming real Panini cards in December
item.description: Panini and Rockstar Games have announced an official GTA VI Sports Trading Card Collection based on the fictional athletes you collect in the game. Here's what's in a box, the rare parallels, and what isn't known yet.

item.title: Sony: GTA 6 is the biggest launch in PlayStation history, with 39 million PS5 players
item.description: Sony says more than 39 million people played GTA VI on PS5 in its first four days, setting a new PlayStation record for players online at once. Here's what Sony announced, and how it fits with the 44.9 million copy estimate doing the rounds.

item.title: GTA 6 patch 01.002.002 notes are out: seven fixes, nothing for performance
item.description: Rockstar has published notes for GTA VI's first post-launch update. It fixes crashes, autosave, stuck wanted levels, story phone calls and more, but nothing about frame rate or the Xbox Quick Resume glitch.

item.title: GTA 6 side secrets: a jet ski dog, a missing persons case and an NPC who thinks he's in a game
item.description: Three GTA VI side secrets picked up by outlets this weekend: how to meet Cool Dog at sea, where to start the Missing Persons case in Port Gellhorn, and the Belville garage covered in simulation theories.

item.title: GTA 6's first post-launch patch is out: update 01.002.002, with no patch notes yet
item.description: Rockstar has started rolling out GTA VI's first update since launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here's the version, the download size, how the staged rollout works and what we know about what it fixes (not much).

item.title: GTA 6 easter eggs found so far: a Fast & Furious car, Dexter's flat and a literal egg
item.description: Players have spent launch week hunting Leonida for secrets. Here are the GTA VI easter eggs outlets have picked up, what's confirmed, and a first-person camera trick Rockstar didn't add on purpose.

item.title: Rockstar's GTA 6 developer notes: 1,000 NPC routines, months on one door, and a plea to skip the guides
item.description: Rockstar gave press a packet of notes from more than 20 GTA VI developers. The highlights, including its design chief asking players to stop chasing completion percentages.

item.title: GTA 6 made $3.79 billion on day one, Take-Two confirms
item.description: Take-Two's first official GTA VI numbers: $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales and 32.5 million copies sold before release, both records. Here's what the figures do and don't include.

item.title: GTA 6 launch bugs: what players are hitting, and why there's no patch yet
item.description: Clipping, falls through the map, cars flying off and a couple of PSN outages. Here's what's actually been reported in GTA VI's first days, what's confirmed and what to do if it happens to you.

item.title: GTA 6 sold an estimated 19 million copies by launch morning, but there's no official number yet
item.description: Market data firm Sensor Tower puts GTA VI at about 19.1 million copies and $1.84 billion by the morning of November 19. Take-Two has not shared figures.

item.title: GTA 6 trophy list: 55 trophies, and the platinum needs 100% completion
item.description: GTA VI has 55 trophies and achievements, all single-player, worth 1,000 Gamerscore. The platinum needs 100% completion, which guides put at about 200 hours.

item.title: GTA 6 does have cheats: 61 of them, and you have to beat the story first
item.description: GTA VI's cheats are entered on the phone with a D-pad code, unlock after the main story, and turn off trophies and saving. The 11 codes two guides agree on so far.

item.title: GTA 6 on Xbox tested: Series X matches PS5, Series S runs at 720p and drops to 20 fps
item.description: Digital Foundry's Xbox results are in. Series X looks and runs much like a base PS5. Series S renders at 720p and often sits below 30 fps.

item.title: GTA 6 is out in New Zealand: what players are finding inside the game
item.description: Kiwi players got GTA VI first, at 11:00 UTC on November 18. Here's what the first hours show, from the prologue to Snapmatic, with spoilers kept behind a warning.

item.title: GTA 6 reviews are in: a 99 on Metacritic, and the complaints worth knowing
item.description: GTA VI's PS5 Metascore stood at 99 from 98 early reviews. What critics loved, what they didn't, and what Digital Foundry found about 30 fps.

item.title: GTA 6 is coming to Xbox One after all, through cloud streaming
item.description: Microsoft says Xbox One owners can stream GTA VI through Xbox Cloud Gaming from November 19 at 1am ET. You still have to buy the game.

item.title: GTA 6 preload is live: start times, 212 GB and how to make room
item.description: Digital GTA VI pre-orders can download now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and boxed copies follow on November 12. What to do before launch.

item.title: Those "leaked" GTA 6 cheat codes are GTA V's. Here's what we know
item.description: Viral posts claim GTA 6 cheat codes have leaked. The lists are GTA V's codes, and Rockstar has not confirmed any cheats for GTA VI.
